name: archetype-modeling
description: Map domain requirements onto software archetypes and distill bounded contexts. Includes the accounting, pricing (valuation), party, roles, ordering, product, plan-vs-execution, graphs, quantity and inventory archetype mappers, a parallel scanner that tests requirements against every known archetype, a builder that extracts new mapper skills from reference implementations and training material, and a context distiller that finds safe generalizations across domain concepts.
